notes: Thresholds were discovered retrospectively using data available through 2026-10-16; historical replay is diagnostic, not out-of-sample validation.
First uncontaminated prospective session is 2026-10-19 or the next market session.
BUY_NOW uses the original H09B entry ask; ARM_TOUCH10 waits until the same contract bid is <= -10% versus original ask and records the contemporaneous ask as the shadow entry.
BLOCK means no DRE shadow entry. No rule in this config can submit broker orders.
